statement: A tenant's boundary is the platform's: only a platform principal sets it (403 otherwise, whatever the operator holds), only a platform principal approves a change that sets one, at approve and again at publish, and only a platform principal rejects or abandons one.
guards: control:ApprovalB2Test#only a platform principal sets a tenant's boundary or approves it
control:ApprovalB2Test#a boundary change a tenant principal approved does not publish
control:ApprovalB2Test#only a platform principal rejects or abandons a boundary change
